text: Prompt Optimizer 是面向 DSH Web 的提示词改写插件。在输入框旁加入改写控件，并在草稿上方显示流式生成的预览。它调用当前会话所选模型，把草稿整理为纯文本、分段或角色任务目标格式；用户可查看结果、复制、应用、撤销或关闭面板。样式可按浏览器覆盖，也可由 profile 设置默认值。适合希望在发送前把想法整理成清晰提示词的 DSH 用户，改写会使用当前会话模型。

Prompt Optimizer is a DSH Web plugin that rewrites composer drafts with the current session model. It adds a composer control and streams a preview. Choose plain, sectioned, or role-task-goal output, then review, copy, apply, or undo the result. A browser override or profile default sets the style.
想在发送前把输入框里的草稿整理成更清楚的提示词。
能不能先预览 AI 改写结果，再决定要不要替换原文？
让 DSH 把随手写的需求改成角色、任务和目标格式。
我希望把提示词改写成带角色、任务、背景和格式小节的版本。
有没有办法复制改写稿，保留输入框里的原草稿？
改写后发现不合适，怎么恢复之前的输入内容？
Rewrite my composer draft into a clearer structured prompt before sending.
Can I preview a prompt rewrite and choose whether to apply it?
Prompt Optimizer 的功能「草稿改写」：将当前输入框草稿交给会话所选模型，生成纯文本、分段或角色任务目标格式的提示词。点击输入框旁的优化控件触发，并以流式事件返回预览。
Prompt Optimizer 的功能「预览与应用」：改写结果显示在输入框上方的面板中，用户可选择使用结果替换草稿，也可复制或关闭面板；应用后可撤销恢复原稿。
Prompt Optimizer 的功能「提示词样式设置」：可选择 plain、sections 或 role-task-goal 输出。profile 提供默认样式，浏览器可保存自己的覆盖值，单次请求也采用有效样式。
Prompt Optimizer 的功能「当前会话模型调用」：插件根据会话解析模型路由，以该 provider 和 model 发起一次改写生成，并把生成内容分块推送到预览面板。
Prompt Optimizer 的改写会将草稿作为提示内容交给当前会话模型生成结果；请求可能产生模型用量，具体服务取决于会话路由。（见 index.js:184-212）

[English](./README.md) · [中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that
optimizes the prompt you are about to send.

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · dsh-prompt-rewrite：It adds a ✨ **Optimize prompt** control next to the composer send button.
Clicking it rewrites the current draft into a structured prompt and streams the
result into a panel above the composer, with **Use**, **Undo**, **Copy**, and
**Close**. Nothing is sent to the agent; the draft is only replaced when you
click **Use**.

It runs on the model the session is already routed to (the same route the next
turn would use), and it never writes to the Session log.

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · Prompt style：The rewritten prompt can take three shapes, chosen in **Settings → General →
Prompt style**:

| Style | Output |
| --- | --- |
| `plain` (default) | One continuous, heading-free prompt. |
| `sections` | `## Role` / `## Task` / `## Context` / `## Format` headings. |
| `role-task-goal` | `Role:` / `Task:` / `Goal:` labeled lines. |

The row stores a per-browser override. A profile can set the default for
everyone through the plugin's `Config`:

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · Prompt style：```yaml
- id: prompt-optimizer
  name: 'dsh-prompt-rewrite'
  config:
    outputStyle: sections

Until the row is changed, it shows that profile default; an override in the row
wins for requests from that browser. The result panel names the style that
produced it.

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · Prompt style：> **Package name:** install `dsh-prompt-rewrite`. The GitHub repository is named
> `dsh-prompt-optimizer`, but that is not this plugin’s npm package name. The
> rewrite engine is [`oss-prompt-optimizer`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/oss-prompt-optimizer).

[Install](#quick-start) · [Local walkthrough](#try-a-rewrite) · [Prompt styles](#prompt-style) · [Implementation](#where-the-rewrite-logic-lives)

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · Try a rewrite：After installation, enter a draft such as “Build a task list for my team” and click **Optimize prompt**. Review the completed result, choose **Use** to replace the draft, or **Copy** to keep it separately. **Undo** restores the draft captured when you clicked Use.

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · Try a rewrite：This is a suggested local walkthrough, not a recorded demo. Output depends on your session’s model and selected prompt style. Rewriting calls the model and may incur provider charges; it does not send the rewritten draft as a conversation turn.

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · Quick start：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-prompt-rewrite
```

Restart the Harness (or refresh the Web UI). A ✨ **Optimize prompt** control appears next to the composer send button.

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-prompt-rewrite
```

Then restart the Harness (or refresh the page for the Client half). The plugin
appears in Settings → Plugins as **Prompt Optimizer**.

Compatibility: DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0`, Node `>=20`.

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · Market：The plugin is listed in the Stijnus market index that the desktop profile already
reads, so it appears in Settings → Plugin Market next to Composer Predictions:

- `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Stijnus/dsh-composer-predictions/main/market-index.json`

This repository also publishes its own format-1 index, for anyone who wants a
focused source:

- `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Stijnus/dsh-prompt-optimizer/main/market-index.json`

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · Market：Market sources are cached for 10 minutes per URL by the Host, so a newly
published version can take that long to show up in an open market panel.

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · Where the rewrite logic lives：| Layer | Module | Symbol |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Meta-prompt builder | `oss-prompt-optimizer/lib/meta.js` | `buildOptimizePrompt(input, language, extraInstructions, examples, outputStyle, metaLanguage, diagnosis, templates, context, taskType, maxOutputTokens, profile, level, builtinExamples, compact, sceneRefEnabled)` |
| Template data | `oss-prompt-optimizer/lib/templates.js` | `META_PROMPT`, `META_PROMPT_EN`, `DEFAULT_TEMPLATES` |
| System-prompt wrapper | `oss-prompt-optimizer/lib/prompt.js` | `buildOptimizeSystem(ctx, input, outputLanguage, diagnosis, profile)` |
| Rewrite executor (full service) | `oss-prompt-optimizer/lib/optimizer.js` | `class PromptOptimizerService`, `optimize(rawInput, options)` |
| Output validation | `oss-prompt-optimizer/lib/validate.js` | `REQUIRED_SECTIONS`, `hasValidSections`, `truncateInput`, … |

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · Where the rewrite logic lives：Those files sit behind the package's `exports` map, which only exposes the root,
`./client`, `./cordis.patch.yml`, and `./package.json`. The root re-exports the
functions this plugin needs, so the supported import is:

```js
import { buildOptimizePrompt, detectLanguage } from 'oss-prompt-optimizer'
```

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · Where the rewrite logic lives：`index.js` builds the meta-prompt with
`buildOptimizePrompt(draft, 'auto', …, 'plain', metaLanguage)`, sends the short
user turn `"只输出优化后的提示词。"` / `"Output only the optimized prompt."`, and
streams the answer back over SSE. That mirrors the upstream
`PromptOptimizerService.optimize()` call shape — but the upstream service itself
is **not** mounted, so this plugin owns its own route, timeout, and SSE framing,
and no second ✨ control or settings panel appears.

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · Where the rewrite logic lives：Those defaults match upstream: `outputLanguage: 'auto'` (no forced-language
line, the rewrite follows the draft) and `outputStyle: 'plain'` (a heading-free
prompt body, which is what the composer holds).

> Deep imports such as `oss-prompt-optimizer/lib/meta.js` are blocked by the
> package `exports` map (`ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`). If a future release
> removes the root re-exports, add an `exports` entry upstream or vendor
> `lib/meta.js` + `lib/templates.js` into this package.

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · Files：| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host half: `POST /prompt-optimizer/optimize` (SSE), owner guard, route resolution, timeout, disconnect handling. |
| `client.js` | Browser half: `conversation.input.right` control and `conversation.input.dock` panel. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the `prompt-optimizer` Host row. |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` | Plugin Manager / Settings display metadata. |
| `icon.svg` | Original artwork. |

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · UI layout notes：`conversation.input.dock` renders entries with **no** width wrapper, so a dock
entry that does not constrain itself becomes full-bleed. The panel adopts the
host's own dock geometry:

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · UI layout notes：- `max-width: var(--dsh-chat-content-width, 920px)` — the inherited transcript /
  composer column (`clamp(680px, column * .64, 920px)`, user-draggable).
- `margin: 0 auto calc(0px - var(--dsh-composer-stack-gap, 6px) - 3px)` and
  top-only `border-radius` with no bottom border, so the panel merges into the
  composer card instead of floating above it.

After a draft is replaced, **Undo** becomes the primary action and the applied
note is an `aria-live` status region.

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm test
```

`npm test` runs the Client render tests (module format, slot registrations,
dock geometry, state transitions) and a Host integration test that streams a
stubbed model call through the real route handler.

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · Local profile install：`install_bundle` links a local directory (`link:`), so the profile's pnpm
install does not install this package's dependencies — Node resolves imports
from the plugin's real path. Run `npm install` in the checkout first, which
creates the local `node_modules/oss-prompt-optimizer` the Host half imports.
Harness packages used inside `oss-prompt-optimizer` (such as
`@deepseek-ai/cordis`) resolve from the DSH installation at runtime.

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · Release：Releases are tag-driven: pushing `vX.Y.Z` runs
`.github/workflows/release.yml`, which checks the tag against `package.json`,
runs the tests, and publishes to npm with a provenance attestation. See
[RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md) for the one-time trusted-publishing setup.

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · License：MIT. The imported rewrite engine is MIT-licensed by its author
([seven282/oss-prompt-optimizer](https://github.com/seven282/oss-prompt-optimizer)).

Interrupted or failed rewrites cannot be applied. The original draft remains editable; only a completed result enables Use. Undo restores the draft captured when Use was clicked.

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · 快速开始：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-prompt-rewrite
```

重启 Harness（或刷新 Web 界面）。输入框发送按钮旁会出现 ✨ **Optimize prompt** 控件。

dsh-prompt-rewrite README · 功能：- **一键改写**：把口语化草稿变成清晰的纯文本、分段、或「角色·任务·目标」结构。
- **流式预览**：改写结果实时出现在输入框上方的面板里。
- **Use / Undo / Copy / Close**：点 **Use** 才会替换草稿，其余动作都不改内容。
- **用当前会话模型**：与下一轮对话同一条路由，无需另配 API key。
- **不写入会话日志**：改写过程不污染会话记录。
- 复用 [`oss-prompt-optimizer`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/oss-prompt-optimizer) 作为改写引擎。
dsh-prompt-rewrite README · 命名说明：本插件以 `dsh-prompt-rewrite` 发布：npm 上 `dsh-prompt-optimizer` 这个名字属于另一位作者，两者无关。旧名 `@stijnus/dsh-prompt-optimizer` 已标记弃用并指向本包。
